name: General English
description: Words a general dictionary misses, mostly scientific, medical and financial.

sources.name: SCOWL (Spell Checker Oriented Word Lists) version 2, release 2026.02.25
sources.attribution: Copyright 2000–2026 by Kevin Atkinson. Australian English data copyright 2016 by Benjamin Titze.
sources.notice: SCOWL's word sizes and regional spellings decided which words qualify and which regions each one belongs to. Word counts from other human-written text, namely books, online forums and question-and-answer sites, news, email, product reviews, web pages, transcripts and corrected learner essays, confirmed words that SCOWL already lists; none of that text is included. The full copyright and permission notices, including Benjamin Titze's for the Australian data, are in LICENSE.txt. Provided as is, without warranty.
